title: Reid-Hillview Airport Maker Fair
description1: Variable Velocity set up a booth at the Reid-Hillview Airport Maker Fair, sharing a FIRST Tech Challenge tent with fellow team Alphabots 16026. We brought our competition robot, a display board on our season and our team banner to introduce families to FIRST robotics.
description2: Team members ran live driving demos on a practice field, explained how the robot is designed, built and programmed, and let curious kids and parents get up close. We also connected with Civil Air Patrol cadets at the event.
bullets: Hosted a team booth alongside FTC team Alphabots 16026
Ran live robot driving demos on a practice field
Explained our design, build and programming process to visitors
Connected with Civil Air Patrol cadets and local families
